profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer-Retired
profile.summary:
My 30 years working as a Senior Software Engineer has exposed me to countless technical and professional challenges working on a wide variety of technical initiatives platform initiatives. 
Those initiative span a wide array of technologies and methodologies that include; Linux and Windows based distributed Services, Simulations, Proof of Concept and trail blazer applications, a variety of CPU and GPU platform initiatives, GPU hardware simulation, parallel hardware architectures, software-multi-threaded applications, visual computing, real-time rendering, developing custom libraries for procedural generation, storage device driver architectures, enterprise architecture performance tuning and architecture consultation, and development of tools, SDKs, plug-ins, and applications.  I’ve done extensive mobile device application programming and have enjoyed several small Raspberry Pi programming tasks. My education bridges both Electrical Engineering and Software Engineering which makes me uniquely suited for software engineering tasks that require extensive interaction between hardware architects and system software initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Intel® Visual Computing Software Division
Games and Graphics Enabling
This unique group is part of Intel’s Software Services Group focusing on the enabling and adoption of Intel Platform initiatives with Game Developer ISV’s.  The goal is to obtain production wins on key Video Game titles. These wins are measured by performance metrics and critical graphics feature adoption that are mutually beneficial to the launch efforts of all parties.  I worked directly with both pre-release binaries and source code to analyze and collaborate on getting features and optimizations implemented. This requires detailed hands on work with the Real-Time Rendering engines based on DirectX 9, DirectX 11 and OpenGL API’s and detailed knowledge of both CPU and GPU programing, as well as game engine architectures, multi-threaded task based implementations, and game asset pipelines. Additional areas of technology enabling included Touch, Sensor, and Networking implementations. Activities also include the research of new and emerging rendering technologies where proof of concept harnesses are designed, implemented, and ultimately reviewed as candidate technologies for dissemination with the game vendor community. This position requires a high level of technical interaction and communication between both external game vendor customers and internal cross divisional stakeholders. The ability to help author and execute Technical Statements of Work is a core requirement. I have a history of ISV relationships with many AAA studios and titles.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
National and Cyber Security-Tactical Solutions
Primary duties are to provide software engineering and architectural support for development teams working in a distributed computing environment that support various military RF signal and imagery Conops. Author, review and implementation of Interface Design Documents for Common Services providers. Primary development focus has been on Java Enterprise Messaging services deployed on distributed Linux Enterprise environments. These services are based on JICD 4.2.1 and AOCO.4033 Common Services protocols. Additional efforts on C/C++ service nodes, and Android mechanisms.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helping to bring game titles to Android platforms.  Extending my previous work with Java and Android Development API's using a combination of Eclipse, Android Studio, and command line tools along with the full development of Native NDK marshaling through JNI and Native interfaces to integrate C/C++ game code bases.  Gaining experience with how Google Play Services, Amazon GameCircle, Expansion file strategies, Map API's, SQLite Databases work and are developed for Android applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Video Games for Mobile Platforms 
Working in an agile production environment maintaining and extending the client application for Heroes of Dragon Age that targets both Android and IOS platforms.  Working primarily using advanced C# constructs a for large code base using Unity3D, Mono, and Visual Studio on both Windows and Mac environments. Extending and creating Java libraries for Android to extend functionality via JNI interfaces.  Extensive use of ADB tools for debugging and configuration of Android target environments.  Wrote custom Unity3D scripts for Art Team productivity tools.  This job requires ability to develop and set up and interface with complex client and server environments and adjust to constantly changing environments.  This job requires the ability to interface with a multi-site team working across multiple time zones.
